hook.name: PmavHookQuoted
hook.description: A bonding curve launchpad hook (pmav.fun quoted lane) that launches fixed-supply coins paired with a quote ERC20 token via a concentrated curve position. Enforces a permanent 2% wallet cap with auto-refund, a 1% fee split 70/30 creator/platform, block+1 anti-snipe gating, and decaying anti-snipe premium on buys. Auto-graduates to a full-range position when the curve sells out 800M tokens.
